assets.negative_control_scope: Whole-hull filling test applies to enclosed component voids. SAL002 has a below-span void outside its overhead hull; its deliberate blocked shell control and wrong-frame marker discrimination are the relevant controls.

method: Independent evaluated source triangles, exact native GLB node transforms, paired source-to-native direction conversion, named source-part contact and solid-join witnesses. Finite clear rays are sampled in all three axes of every declared preserved void, with independent blocked structural controls. Actual source and native visual intersections are compared with collision compounds; a whole-component hull supplies negative controls.
limits: Finite probes are not continuous coverage/error certification, engine physics, real host moving-door fit, service procedure, guard compliance or universal actor/cart fit.
Source markers classify fixed physical surfaces separately from optional receivers, openings and pose datums. Native clips/skins are counted; no absent motion is inferred.
